title: Bias Analysis and Regularization of Sequential Minimal Optimization in Variational Quantum Eigensolvers
summary: The Nakanishi Fujii Todo (NFT) algorithm, also known as Rotosolve, implements Sequential Minimal Optimization for Variational Quantum Eigensolvers (SMO-VQE) by exploiting the trigonometric dependence of the energy on individual circuit parameters. This enables analytical one-dimensional minimization using only a few , typically two, energy evaluations, but introduces bias in the estimated energy.
